purpose: Self-contained synthetic UI input→expected-state contracts. CURRENT_REPRODUCTION uses source-derived baseline outputs. OPTIONAL_FUTURE cases retain proposed improvements without requiring them for current-product parity. No production API or real execution is claimed.

clock.rule: Every case resets a fake clock: Date.now() = Date.parse(baseIso) + event.at. Convert numeric raw task/event/operation timestamp fields (startedAt,updatedAt,time,operation.startedAt) to ISO at base+ms. Convert numeric observer/eligibility timestamps (startedAfter,frozenAt,lastConfirmedAt,liveSince,sessionLiveSince,now) to numeric epoch base+ms. Zero in connection frozenAt is a sentinel only when explicitly labelled unset; otherwise it means offset0. Keep durations, elapsedMs, remainingMs, counters, page numbers, IDs and generation/inputEpoch unchanged. events.at remains a relative scheduling offset; elapsed expectations are duration offsets, never absolute epoch.

conventions.generators: The explicitly written finite sequences are fixture data generation, not production matching heuristics.

conventions.deviation: Read contractClass before using outputs as product acceptance. BASELINE_OBSERVATION and source-derived cases are CURRENT_REPRODUCTION oracles, including documented limitations. OPTIONAL_FUTURE does not supersede baseline. Legacy gateIds on future cases only identify future verification areas; they do not make the improvement mandatory for current reproduction.
